equation: aggregate mean per-NPU bandwidth = f_short_C*b_short + (1-f_short_C)*b_long. Enforcing disk rho <= r requires f_short_C <= (10*r-b_long)/(b_short-b_long).
scope: Necessary long-run aggregate bandwidth constraint for this fixed set of raw profiles and fixed ratios inside each group; not a universal bound on arbitrary SS distributions or any intermediate window. Counts are discrete, so the fractional upper bound does not guarantee every population below it satisfies actual per-SSU or deadline constraints.
